ddl:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "InventoryWarehouseEditAudit" (
  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  "storeId" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "productId" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "stocktakeId" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "grantId" TEXT NOT NULL,
  "before" JSONB NOT NULL,
  "after" JSONB NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "InvoiceQrSupplierLearning" (
      "companyId" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "supplierVat" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "providerFormat" TEXT NOT NULL,
      "supplierName" TEXT,
      "verifiedCount" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      "firstVerifiedAt" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
      "lastVerifiedAt" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
      PRIMARY KEY ("companyId","supplierVat","providerFormat")
    )

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "InvoiceStockExclusionEmail" (
        "companyId" TEXT NOT NULL, "storeId" TEXT NOT NULL, "orderId" TEXT NOT NULL,
        "reopenVersion" INTEGER NOT NULL, "payload" JSONB NOT NULL,
        "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "nextAttemptAt" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
        "sentAt" TIMESTAMPTZ, PRIMARY KEY ("companyId","storeId","orderId","reopenVersion")
      )
ALTER TABLE "InvoiceStockExclusionEmail" ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "messageId" TEXT, ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS "lastFailure" TEXT

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "PosInternalTransfer" (
    "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    "companyId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "sourceStoreId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "destinationStoreId" TEXT,
    "externalDestinationName" TEXT,
    "createdByUserId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "idempotencyKey" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "createdAt" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    CHECK (num_nonnulls("destinationStoreId", "externalDestinationName") = 1),
    CHECK ("sourceStoreId" <> "destinationStoreId"),
    CHECK (length(btrim("externalDestinationName")) > 0),
    UNIQUE ("companyId", "sourceStoreId", "idempotencyKey")
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "PosInternalTransferLine" (
    "transferId" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "PosInternalTransfer" ("id"),
    "productId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "quantity" NUMERIC(14,4) NOT NULL CHECK ("quantity" > 0),
    "unitCost" NUMERIC(14,6) NOT NULL CHECK ("unitCost" >= 0),
    "vatRate" NUMERIC(7,4) NOT NULL CHECK ("vatRate" BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
    PRIMARY KEY ("transferId", "productId")
)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "PosInternalTransferSettlement" (
    "transferId" TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES "PosInternalTransfer" ("id"),
    "method" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK ("method" IN ('CASH', 'BANK_TRANSFER')),
    "amount" NUMERIC(14,2) NOT NULL CHECK ("amount" >= 0),
    "bankReference" TEXT,
    "cashReceiptTransactionId" TEXT UNIQUE,
    "recordedByUserId" TEXT NOT NULL,
    "recordedAt" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
    CHECK (("method" = 'BANK_TRANSFER') = ("bankReference" IS NOT NULL)),
    CHECK (length(btrim("bankReference")) > 0)
)

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "PosInternalTransfer_destination_idx"
    ON "PosInternalTransfer" ("companyId", "destinationStoreId", "createdAt")

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "StoreStockPackage" ("companyId" TEXT NOT NULL,"storeId" TEXT NOT NULL,"productId" TEXT NOT NULL,"baseProductId" TEXT NOT NULL,"unitsPerPackage" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK("unitsPerPackage">1),"updatedBy" TEXT NOT NULL,"updatedAt" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),PRIMARY KEY("storeId","productId"),CHECK("productId"<>"baseProductId"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "PosPackageStockPosting" ("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY,"companyId" TEXT NOT NULL,"storeId" TEXT NOT NULL,"saleId" TEXT NOT NULL,"lineId" TEXT NOT NULL,"productId" TEXT NOT NULL,"baseProductId" TEXT NOT NULL,"unitsPerPackage" INTEGER NOT NULL,"quantity" NUMERIC(14,4) NOT NULL,"createdAt" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),UNIQUE("storeId","lineId"))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "PosScannedCashReturn"("id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY,"companyId" TEXT NOT NULL,"storeId" TEXT NOT NULL,"terminalPos" TEXT NOT NULL,"actorId" TEXT NOT NULL,"requestHash" TEXT NOT NULL,"resultJson" JSONB NOT NULL,"createdAt" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW())

triggers.name: mws_guard_package_stock_change

reviewSemantics.InventoryWarehouseEditAudit: Store-scoped audit retains product, stocktake and access-grant identity plus before/after values. No rewriting or scoped export under this profile.
reviewSemantics.InvoiceStockExclusionEmail: Store-scoped outbox retains order identity, original payload and external SMTP message identifier. No queue reset, replay or writer changes.
reviewSemantics.PosInternalTransfer: Shared source/destination store and actor identities remain intact. This profile assigns no store ownership and disables scoped lifecycle execution.
reviewSemantics.PosInternalTransferLine: Transfer child identity and company product identity remain intact with the original physical FK.
reviewSemantics.PosInternalTransferSettlement: Transfer, receiving cash transaction and recording actor references remain intact with the original financial record.
reviewSemantics.PosPackageStockPosting: Store-scoped historical sale, sale-line, package and base-product references remain intact.
reviewSemantics.PosScannedCashReturn: Actor and immutable idempotency response preserve sale/session references inside resultJson. No replay or scoped removal.
reviewSemantics.StoreStockPackage: Package configuration retains product/base-product and updating actor identities. Existing stock guard remains enforced.
